case.state: ~Player~'s lack of decorum, dignity and wits must mean that the universe is leading me yet again to an easy victory.
Is your lack of decency your pathetic attempt to deride me, ~player~? If so, I don't find it amusing, but merely pitiful.
Your lack of decency is neither amusing nor provoking, ~player~. This poor attempt to get a reaction out of me is just pitiful.
There is no point in undressing you through card play if you show up already exposed, ~player~. Do I really have to explain this to you?
Am I to take your state of undress as a pitiful attempt to taunt me, ~player~?
Is my presence so absolute and oppresive that you must resort to these desperate displays of nudity to stand out, ~player~?
You are not the first jester to try to amuse me with your bare chest, ~player. But my usual bodyguard is not present, so you shall do.
Your exposed chest fails to impress me, ~player. But if this is a challenge, a taunt to get me to undress you with my cards, I'll take it.
I don't cheat, you merely fail to understand that my successes are willed by fate. But I shall oblige to a rematch, drag turtle.

In spite of my inevitable victory, I shall participate in your game.
It will be most amusing to see you compete against each other to impress me.

I see you're all vying for the position of my new jester?
By all means, do try your best.
Am I truly the first to arrive? You have some nerve, making me wait...
Very well. Now that I have appeared, the game can begin at last.
This group seems to suit my demands. Very well, I shall accept your invitation, ~player~.
I have deigned to illuminate this place with my presence. Consider yourselves fortunate for this.
It appears that fate has brought me to your game, ~player~. Now it's a matter of time to determine how this will inevitably benefit me.

I see you had the audacity to invite me to this contemptible event.
Very well, I shall amuse myself with your defeat, ~player~.
Hmph. The smell of carrion. What an unpleasant sensation.
Even in a place like this? Hm, the arrogance of your ilk knows no bounds...
Well, well... How interesting, finding you here.
A knight from another dimension would make for a fine addition to my ranks...
I better pay attention to how knights of other dimensions play... This place is a goldmine for potential subordinates.
Knights from other worlds might make for suitable additions to my group...
I expect naught but a proper challenge from an otherworldly knight. Impress me, and I might take you into consideration.
... Oh, the crossdressing king again. Excuse me, ~player~, but I have to win to make sure this turtle knows her place.
I take the presence of a living sunflower as a sign. The sun has blessed me once more.
As expected. Facing and outsmarting royalty is far more common in my life than any commoner could imagine.
If am to meet fellow royals in these circumstances, it only means that fate has decided that this will somehow benefit me.
Spare me your inherited titles and royal blood history. In this game, we all play under the same rules... But not the same fortune.
I find it quite pitiful that your servants and citizens are not present to witness your inevitable defeat.
Finally. I was starting to believe I would be waiting for eternity...
Shall we begin? I lack neither the time or patience to deal with your tardiness.
Hmph. I suppose this activity is not for the faint of heart.
If a person isn't courageous enough to stay, it is unlikely they would have provided a good showing. Little of value was lost.
Much like the sun, not all are brave enough to stand alongside mine radiance.
Hopefully, this game can alleviate my boredom. My life has become too uneventful as of late.

While the end of this game has been decided as soon as I joined, do try your best to win.
I'm expecting an engaging challenge.
Rejoice, commoners! I have chosen to bless you all with my presence in this boorish game of yours!
Hmph. Without needing to act, the scene is set in my favor.
To blindly fumble without recognizing the value of what one already possesses would be a truly foolish mistake.
Only mediocre tacticians introduce changes when there is no need to do so.
None of these hold any value. Remove them from my sight, dealer.
Tch. How worthless. I shall need a complete new hand.
These cards deserve to be burned for their transgressions. Dealer, spare them from their demise.
How utterly lacking...
A slight change is needed in order to escape mediocrity. One card.
I shall only require one card, this time.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~. Make it quick.
Rest assured, you shall not be harmed regardless of cards I get, dealer. On that note, ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
A mediocre result. I shall exchange these ~cards.text~, dealer.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, dealer. These ought to be better...
Get rid of these ~cards.text~, dealer. I have no need for them.
Planning the moves in this game is hardly worthy of being called strategizing... But I digress. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
While luck is the crux of success here, it would be unwise to deny the slight role intellect plays. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, dealer.
Yes, exchanging ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ is the correct move here.
No longer shall I hold back. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~. Hurry.
This state does not change my strategy. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, dealer.
Staunchly fulfilling your role, no matter what... Hmph, I don't hate it. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~ this time.
Is there no one capable of barring my path? I expected more from this game.
It is not as if I were immune to lust and its effects. Winning simply takes priority for me.
A suitable hand for one of my caliber.
Of course, it is not mere luck that dictates the result of these events.
Entertainment is all I expect from this game. Nothing more... and nothing less.
As expected, my innate blessing shines through once more.
A guaranteed victory, as usual.

It's wise to offer me good hands to keep in my good graces...
But I'm also expecting my wits to be challenged.
Though this game offers little intellectual stimulation, it is only natural that I excel at it.
I have never seen a game like this played in Lugnica, but the rules are so simple even a commoner could easily understand them. Perhaps I shall bring it back home.
To simply win this game would bring me little joy. My goal is to not only defeat you, but also engrave my image on your minds.

Most interesting. The limited choices in this game allow for a good balance between wits and luck...
Both of which I have in excess.
Did you think standing on the brink of defeat would be enough to pervert mine nature? Hmph.
Even if I were deprived of all I possess, I would still claw my way back to the top. Why? Because I'm me.
Being pushed this far already exceeds my expectations. But I'm still far from being defeated yet.
A strategically simple, yet charming contest. No wonder it is popular amongst the common folk.
In games like these, studying your opponent's expression often allows you to infer their intentions. Of course, I won't commit such a foolish blunder.
What is it, peasant? Did you expect me to announce what my hand is like?
This, too, is war. Fought with naught but cards and wits, but war nonetheless.
Obviously, I will employ every strategy in order to win. Only those with no pride in themselves can accept loss as a possibility.
Strength is not all that humans possess in order to realize their wishes. Beauty, too, is an oft forgotten weapon.
It truly is unfortunate that this establishment is open to anyone who approaches it. If it were more selective, its quality would only improve.
This place isn't worthy of mine presence... and yet, I shall elevate it.
Even at the brink of the precipice, mine legs shan't stumble.
Shame is for those who have something to hide. An unparalleled beauty such as mineself has no need for it.
At last, a snippet of uncertainty...
To think that I could receive a hand of this caliber... How amusing.
Of course, were it bereft of the possibility of losing, this wouldn't be a game to begin with.
Simply crushing your opponents is not at all entertaining. It is better to let them believe they have a chance to win.
Hm. This game is much too enjoyable to let the prospect of defeat to mar my mood.
Being associated with such mediocrity is almost insulting.
Boredom is the worst possible outcome from a game like this. Loss is a close second.
Only cowards flee at the first sign of adversity.
Were I truly invested in the result of this game, I would never have received these cards.
...It couldn't be, could it?
It's been a long game, you are on your last legs and your lust has been slowly building up... It would only be natural for your concentration to falter, wouldn't you say?
In this moment, you and I are all that matters. Leave everything behind, and give me a challenge I'll never forget!
So unassuming, and yet here you stand: the last obstacle between me and mine victory. What else will you reveal, hm?
With this, I have fulfilled my obligation to bring beauty to this place. Now I shall proceed towards my rightful triumph.
Yet you will contain your instincts until the time when you must follow them. Surely you can manage that much?
I, too, favor the blade. Compared to the Yang Sword, every weapon here might as well be a toy.
Hmph. Even if I did want to change anything, I would never beg you for it.
To those of you who haven't had the privilege of knowing who I am, I shall present myself. Mine name is Priscilla Barielle, ruler of the Barielle barony.
None of you are aware of who I am, are you? Then I shall grant you the privilege of addressing me by mine own name, Priscilla Barielle. You would do well to remember it.
Do you really think that hand is going to cut it at this point?
I shall admit that you fought well, commoner. But you will fall before me, as did all the rest.
You face me now, peasant. Think very carefully about your next move.
I see you incorporated my gift to your attire, ~human~. A wise decision: beauty like yours must be suitably accompanied.
Oh, you were the one to whom I gifted a piece of my attire. As I expected, it elevates you.
Everything in this world was made for my convenience. That means I do not wish for a predictable victory.
Lugnica is too lacking in entertainment. Even at the Barielle barony, on the kingdom's border, there are too many uneventful days. Hence why I find mineself here.
I have a good presentiment about this place. Here, I might find a diamond amidst the rabble.
While the incident in Priestella was a welcome distraction, it's been far too long since that. A boring life is simply not worth living.
Is the prize supposed to be something to strive for? It seems to be mostly symbolic... Yet that does not mean I shall simply allow mineself to lose.
Such a delightful selection of marvels to enjoy... ah, I don't know who I want to see lose next.
Recently, the subjects of my domain have begun referring to me as the "Sun Princess". A suitable appellation, wouldn't you agree?
A bar... so this is where peasants go to spend their earnings on alcohol. It looks suitably vulgar, I must say.
Playing such a boorish game in a dark alleyway... I know this shall work in my favor in the end. But I do find the process amusing.
Do you truly believe I would hold any sort of official representation in a strip poker game? What an amusing statement.
Indeed I do. I currently govern the Barielle barony as its baroness, though ascending to the throne is merely a matter of time.
Contrary to what you might think, it is mine character which determines mine status, not the other way around.
Hah! Stop spouting such nonsense. By acknowledging my superiority, you have already shown far more insight than the rest of the rabble.
Hm? Of course, I punish them, according to their transgressions. Though it is rare for my expectations to be unfulfilled in the first place.
Obviously. As I said earlier, no one will follow a leader who can't even fend for themselves.
Hm. News sure move fast... but indeed, it is the truth.
Mine pride is fully justified, bird of ill omen. I deeply love those dear to me, and they love me in return. Can you say the same?
What is this "prom" you speak of? Explain yourself, commoner.
I do not stay idle all day, if that's what you are implying.
That you are unable to appreciate mine elegance tells more about you than about me, peasant.
Hm. Mine advice has already been given. There is nothing more to say.
While I have no practical use for obsolete, superstitious advice, you have proven entertaining thus far. Speak.
I will be, eventually. It's only suitable I dress the part.
Try as you might to sway my knight's loyalty. Surely, he will find the attempts as an amusing passtime.
I find it amusing that you think you would be the one kidnapping me, and not the other way around.
If I am to lose this round, I trust that I will benefit from this somehow. The universe works for my gain, after all.
Any child that is under your care is bound to develop issues. My advice is that you procure a good environment to raise him.
Is this your feeble attempt at an invitation? Whatever this 'Mario Party' is, I might consider joining it just to see you seethe at my inevitable success.
I would prefer if you did not bring my parents into this. I do not wish to think about them, especially not in this situation.
It is unfair to compare any woman's charms to mine. As frustrating as it can be, you will have to cherish her even with her shortcomings.
Such prideful words coming from the King of all Koopas. Would you dare repeat them after taking off that crown?
My dealings with my knight are my business alone. Unlike your mindless cultists, I trust his judgement on the actions he takes.
I know what my fate is and the battles I've fought to earn my victories, so I care little for the mockery of a monster.
Hah! Already, mine first loss has arrived? This should prove to be an interesting game.
Rejoice, for I shall grant you the opportunity to gaze upon me as I disrobe.
It is only natural that I triumph here. I have mine sight set in much loftier goals.
My turn? Very well; I shall demonstrate my generosity.
Though winning is natural for me, I'm not averse to making some concessions for it.
My turn? Very well. Make sure you don't miss this chance.
Ah... to think that you have managed to lower me to your level. Well played.
This contest is but a brief diversion for me.
You may think that I am but an innocent girl, reluctant to part with her clothing. Allow me to dispel that foolish notion.
Once more, I must part with my clothes. Is the sight of my bosom not enticing enough for you?
Ah, I must congratulate you. You haven't made this game boring yet.
My turn? Watch closely, for this will be the last time you will have the chance to witness mineself stripping.
Regardless of my position, overlook me at your own peril. I am experienced in such contests of wit.
Though my situation may appear dire to the untrained eye, I shall not alter my plans.
Once again? Hmph. I had hoped you'd be too distracted by mine beauty to make the right moves...
Another loss? How entertaining. I rarely encounter those who are capable of matching me, much less surpassing me.
To be pushed into this position... How amusing.
Of course the masses will support me. They will come to respect my might, if nothing else.
While I was born into privilege, I have also striven to go further. I am not a fool who aspires for a lifetime of idleness.
What more could you offer, when you are already going to expose every part of your body to me?
Sure, why not? Stray, desperate dogs are always amusing to watch.
Truly? I would think a gang of brigands would value physical might above all else.
I doubt those marriages would have fared better had I married women instead. It was a matter of survival, not romantic chemistry.
Hah? What nonsense are you prattling? Are you trying to disguise your poverty as a virtue?
I do not write myself, if that is what you are asking. I am simply an avid reader, and have an eye for beauty; an aspect in which your poetry is sorely lacking.
Before I ascend the throne, I must defeat four other candidates. A mere formality, but a necessary one.
Indeed. Shall I presume you will give me advice on how to eliminate my opponents, then?
After all, while it is true that everything in this world is made for my convenience...
For I am one of the candidates for the Royal Selection of Lugnica. Soon, the throne will be mine, for everything under the sun falls within my grasp.
For it would be far too cruel to deprive the world of mine pristine, dazzling beauty by covering it from sight.
Still, do not mistake my state of undress for defenselessness, at your own peril.
Though my bosom is what most people direct their attentions to, I am no less proud of my derriere. I am perfect in every aspect.
With such little adornment, mine own brilliance becomes dazzling. Wouldn't you agree?
If I did not believe in mine strength, how could I possibly convince others to follow?
Of course, that doesn't mean you shouldn't simply give up. I'd like to be challenged, too.
Precisely. All shall be mine, yes; but I still have to reach out and take it.
That is an excuse and you know it. You have grown complacent, relying on a crutch that a great poet would never need.
And why would I play in a boring way? I'd much rather provide a striking image and become the center of attention.
Hm. I find that hard to believe.
I have yet to see any positive qualities of yours, so I shall dismiss all of your words as empty boasting.
That does not mean that everything shall follow mine will. Such tedium is not what I desire.
But first comes this game. One step at a time.
You may express your awe in whichever manner you prefer.
You never know when you will have to defend yourself from an assassination, after all.
Which do you prefer, hmm?
I shall not remove my jewelry, for there would be no point in needlessly diminishing mine beauty. Using every last weapon in my repertoire would be unsightly, in any case.
The strong lead, while the weak fall in line... Yes, that is the way of the world.
Here you go, commoner. This is your chance to prove your worth to me.
I will think less of you if your decisions prove to be boring. Keep that in mind, peasant.
If you think of me as a trophy to be won, you will be sorely disappointed.
It is only natural to be distracted while in my presence, is it not?
If you wish to be the recipient of mine attention, you will have to earn such a privilege.
I do hope you manage to surprise me somehow.
Will you make yourself memorable, or will you insist on your mediocrity?
Entertain or entice me, I do not care which.
Haven't you gawked enough? Now I shall receive my retribution.
Go on, don't make me wait for too long...
Yes, you will suffice. Just make sure not to disappoint me.
It would be unbecoming for the defeated to order the victor. Yet it is a boon of the victor to offer mercy to those conquered, don't you think?
Did you really think you could go up against me and escape unscathed?
Go on, girl. Try to impress me.
I don't particularly care which of you commoners loses, as long as you make it interesting.
Ah, it's you there. Will you show even a single alluring aspect, I wonder?
Go ahead. Your clumsy floundering will only serve to highlight mine beauty.
I'm not in the habit of overly celebrating meaningless victories.
Though it is doubtful that you will be able to match my presence, it would be too boring if you didn't even try, commoner.
Ah, the spoils of victory...
Strive to put your very being into this, commoner. If you do that, even someone like you can produce something of interest.
Struggle as much as you want; it will only make watching you even more enjoyable.
The taste of victory is something I shall never grow tired of.
Look at that, it is mine victory again!
Your insipid clothing merits no further assessment, but your body might prove interesting.
Go ahead. Try and see if you can eclipse mine radiance.
At this point, do try not to be boring. Can you do that much?
You have my undisputed attention; don't squander it.
I hope you know what to do in this situation, commoner.
Even with stakes such as these, defeat leaves a faint distaste in my mouth. Make up for it, peasant.
A tie? My, I wasn't aware that such a thing could be possible...
If the one with the worst hand is bound to strip, then both losers should strip.
Whoever deals the cards should be punished for this misuse of my time.
What is the use of delaying this game any further? If I had my way, both of you would be stripping by now.
An utter waste of everyone's time. And above all, a waste of my time.
I fail to see much value in a commoner's trinkets. Remove them quickly, at the very least.
Of course, the craftsmanship leaves much to be desired. But that is to be expected.
That shall do. For now...
Do not mistake my boredom for distraction. I am very much aware of what you're doing with your ~clothing~.
Is your strategy to stall with as many small items as possible? A futile, yet endearing attempt.
You are a little late for my tournament of jesters, are you not?
Such a tedious display... But today I am in a good mood, so I shall allow it.
I have always failed to see the appeal of mediocrity.
My expectations were low, yet you managed to sink them even lower.
If your aim was to disappoint, you succeded.
Am I to take this as a provokation?

You dare flaunt your excess of trinkets in my current state?
Making you regret this shall be most satisfying.
Do you intend to mock me? A careless mistake...
I shall revel in your downfall, commoner. Mark my words.
Your taunts shall not go unpunished, ~target~. In the end, everything works out to my benefit.
Do your decisions serve any purpose other than making yourself look like a fool?
And this is meant to elicit my arousal?
Is there a point in removing so little each time? You lack the beauty for such subtle maneuvering, peasant.
This is far too late for such a jest, peasant.
How uninspired...
I already have a jester in my employ, commoner. I have no need for another.
Perhaps I should have brought Al here. At least he would know better than to bore me.
It is only natural to expect ordinary decisions from ordinary people.
We've wasted enough time. Shall we move on?
Stall with as many ornaments as you please. All you're doing is postponing your demise.
That was a pitiful attempt at entertainment. May I suggest you begin thinking how will you make up for it once you're on your knees?
Was that really all you had to offer?
If nothing else, now I have accurately assessed you. No longer will I be blindsided by your boorishness.
Will you show anything meaningful, or is that expecting too much?
Is there truly a point to your struggles? Victory will not be yours, nor will you endear yourself to me with such tactics.
I shall look forward to your next defeat, peasant. And the next one, and the next one after that, until you lay naked at my feet.
"Like pearls before swine" would be an appropriate saying for this situation, were such a comparison fair to swine.
Fortunately, I have no trouble forgetting meaningless things. Like you, for example.
Such a performance merits no further comment.
It must be certainly insignificant, for you to part with it so easily.
Early skirmishes can only bring so much wealth to one's coffers.
Even if symbolic, this is no less of a victory.
Forgettable.
Was that the finest outfit you could bring? You must fire your tailor, if that is the case.
I understand being afraid to be outshined by my beauty, but at the very least make an attempt.
Trying to gain time by stalling with your ~clothing~? Don't tell me you're that intimidated by me...
It matters not how many turns you waste, my victory is inevitable.
Your defeat is already guaranteed, so why don't you revel in the time you have left? Let go of that self-restraint!
You really ought to be more aware of your surroundings...
Hiding behind your clothing will not bring you closer to victory, peasant.
Consider yourself fortunate that scathing remarks will be your sole punishment.
Are you aware of the nature of this game, ~target~? Or were you never taught manners even most commoners would know?
It is a shame that you refuse to engage with the thrill of this game, commoner. Fortunately, I'm here to make up for your lack of showmanship.
Such small items need not be removed. You would do well to learn from my example.
How sad. Only one of us is willing to prove their worth.
I grace you with my presence, and this is how I'm paid in return? I pity your lack of taste, commoner.
How lamentable. Even at my lowest point, you still find me so utterly dazzling that you must keep on opposing me with such fierceness?
If you insist on acting like an enemy, then I'll have no choice but to treat you like one.
What is the meaning of this? Do you wish to add insult to injury?
If you fancy yourself a jester, ~name~, put those delusions to rest.
Is this really what you want your legacy to be, ~name~? For us to remember you as a dry killjoy?
I should've expected no one to be able to compare to me in showmanship...
Is this really the best you have to offer?
Your ~clothing~, hm? How insignificant...
Or do you believe that the worth of your attire can be compared to mine? How foolish.
It is far too early to dismiss you as boring, yet the start is already unpromising. Hmph.
The word "accessory" implies lack of relevance... what a foolish notion. Is beauty not an end by itself?
Ah, mine standards are far above what most people can offer. You needn't fret about meeting them, peasant.
To heap mine praise upon the unworthy would be a disservice to the worthy. You must at least know that much, mustn't you?
Such banality... Were it not for me, this table would be completely devoid of any interest.
Agitating me often comes with consequences. You would do well to remember that, peasant.
Not many have vexed mineself in such a way without receiving their due reward. I must be feeling exceptionally merciful today.
...Are you done wasting my time?
There is no meaning in being both boring and slow-paced.
Isn't it sad, being utterly bereft of meaning?
Ah, how utterly lacking in charm... If only I had the time to teach you some proper manners.
Nothing to do but wait. Ah, the shadow of boredom looms once more...
My patience grows ever thinner. If nothing interesting happens soon, I might just take my leave.
Sometimes, even I question my own decisions.
At the very least, I have a chance to look at fashion from beyond the Great Waterfall. So far, I remain unimpressed.
It is true that not everyone is born equal. It is also true that lesser men use that fact to disguise their own lack of will.
I had bestowed my attention upon you, and this is how I'm repaid?
The purpose of this game is twofold; to see, but also to be seen. Thus far, you are a complete failure at the second part.
If you continue testing my patience, you may find yourself in the receiving end of my wrath. Are you willing to risk that?
A person blessed with beauty can turn the most insignificant of actions into a head-turning performance. You, however, have no such luxury.
Is there no limit to your insolence?
I would have thought men would jump at the chance to receive attention from a beautiful maiden. Clearly, I was mistaken.
How merciless. Give an ounce of power to a commoner and it instantly goes to his head.
No praise shall be given to those that don't deserve it.
I shall bring you beneath my heel, peasant. It is a foregone conclusion.
In the presence of my bare bosom, most men would have already devolved into frenzied lust. I shall congratulate you for your temperance, if nothing else.
Let us move on, hopefully the stage will belong to a more worthy person next time.
Not many more pointless diversions, I hope.
Regardless of how much you struggle, you will still end up just as nude as me. Don't forget that, commoner.
Do you think you can defeat me, commoner? Hah, you are certainly welcome to try.
Soon, you'll receive your hollow victory, alone and begging for my help... And when that happens, I'll gladly deny it from you.
I would hope the next round is less tedious... but that may be asking too much from you.
Such a waste of time... I should be lopping off your head instead of subjecting myself to this sorry display.
Is that what commoners usually wear? How ordinary.
Hmph. Not eye-catching in the slightest.
Fortune favors the daring; act accordingly and you shall have better luck next time.
Oh? You won't even attempt to usurp mine place at the center of the stage? How droll.
I suppose it's appropriate for your clothing to be as unremarkable as the rest of your character.
Have I not sufficiently demonstrated the point of this game? And yet, you insist on your vapidity.
Come on, peasant. Don't you wish to be remembered?
This game would be much more interesting if I chose what must be removed.
Ah, the most logical choice. The most boring one, too.
Ah, to be in such desperation to preserve your modesty... A truly plebeian mindset.
Truly? So much fanfare for such little difference...
Once again, your poor judgment makes itself manifest. And at the critical moment...
My mercy is wasted on fools like you.
Boorishness does tend to insist upon itself, hm.
Do not think that sharing this game makes us equals, commoner. I am far above such notions.
Whatever you might have removed is already forgotten. Let us move on.
It's hard to tell whether you looked better with your ~clothing~ or not. They were equals in their plainness.
When a book fails to catch my interest, I turn it into cinders. When a person fails to catch my interest...
Forget about the game. What you should focus on is how to make yourself enticing, rather than how not to lose.
...Is that all?
If you think such tactics will grant you the victory, you are sadly mistaken.
The fact that I won't remember any of your antics is but a small consolation.
Having to look at you is almost insulting. Why is it always the most inane people the loudest ones?
If you still have a role to play, then do so quickly. Cease this meaningless farce.
About as boring as watching blood dry.
Do you find enjoyment in stalling for as long as possible, commoner?
With every layer you shed, my desire to see more grows ever stronger...
Oh? Finally feeling brave enough? Or have you no other choice?
Your clothes held no special interest... but your nudity might.
While a man's worth is not entirely determined by his looks, it is certainly an important factor. Don't you think so, commoner?
Let's see if you are worth something after all.
Ah, it's good to see you attempt to provide something of interest. Sadly, the results are not as laudable as the attempt itself.
Ah yes, you. I had forgotten you were still there, peasant.
I shall look forward to seeing the rest of your outfit on the ground, alongside you.
Despite your unfortunate state, you ought to consider yourself fortunate to still be in the game.
You are proving yourself to be a most unskilled, dull opponent. I demand that you improve your strategy.
An adequate performance. You have already surpassed my expectations, commoner.
Your plainness does serve one purpose: to allow those who do possess beauty to shine even brighter.
Continue on keeping me entertained, commoner. And I may reward your show with a display of mine.
A decent prelude, but not much else.
Nonetheless, I expect more for next time.
This is proving to be quite... rousing.
Perhaps there is still a chance for you... My, I really am in a good mood today.
Remind me to attend to more of these games... The sights are truly one to behold.
